title: data/bluesky.json
description: The Bluesky post each blog post was shared in, so a post can show the replies to it beside its comments (js/bluesky-replies.js). Written weekly by .github/scripts/refresh_bluesky.py from my public author feed. An entry the feed no longer reaches is kept; one whose Bluesky post has been deleted is dropped.

posts.description: One entry per blog post that has been shared, the newest share first. A post shared more than once keeps its most recent share.

slug.description: The blog post: its file name without .html (blog/<slug>.html).

uri.description: The Bluesky post's at:// URI, which the browser hands to app.bsky.feed.getPostThread.

url.description: The same post's page on bsky.app, where a reader replies.

posted.description: When the Bluesky post was made, UTC. Decides which share is the most recent.
